qrandomparity_n10.description: Fixed 100-instance QRandomParity benchmark at n=10. Lower runtime is better, but speed only counts if the solver still returns decisive answers across the batch.

median_runtime_s.description: Median runtime over solved instances — primary metric, measures typical-case performance.

instances_solved.description: Count of instances solved within timeout — correctness constraint, rewards reliability.

mean_runtime_s.description: Mean runtime over solved instances — triangulates median by upweighting outlier-sensitive mean.

p90_runtime_s.description: 90th percentile capped runtime over the fixed slice, treating unsolved or over-timeout instances as the timeout — anti-shortcut metric, penalizes tail latency and unsolved cases.
